Messages.Author: Contempt
Messages.Body:
I want to have a clarification on one of the most powerful cards in
the VTES games:

Tortured Confession.
pay 1 blood

Only usable when the opposing vampire goes into torpor, not usable by
a vampire going into torpor. Combat ends. You may look at the opposing
vampire's controller's hand.

... as their is a combat ends after the torpor resolution, does this
prevent the opposing minion from going into torpor?

Regards
Contempt...
ps: if u be really really nice, or flame in a creative fashion, i'll
actually inform you why im interested in this card... and no, i dont
want to put together a deck based on vamp's with bad mascara (check
image)

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Contempt wrote:
> Tortured Confession.

No.

Messages.Author: Daz
Messages.Body:
Can the acting minion play TC before the other vamp can play Undead
persistance to stop going to torpor? (Thus ending combat and sending
the other vamp to torpor).
